statement: At the pinned mainline Linux v7.3 revision, the in-tree xpad USB ID table matches Xbox 360 wireless receivers but does not match any of the four Xbox Wireless Adapter products handled by out-of-tree xone. Therefore stock xpad does not provide the xone adapter GIP receiver lifecycle. This negative code comparison is bounded to xpad, not an exhaustive proof about every mainline subsystem.

applicability.revision: Out-of-tree xone f2aa9fe01103d7600553b505b298ff0bd47ff280; Linux v7.3 or pinned SDL where cited
applicability.scope: Linux v7.3 drivers/input/joystick/xpad.c:105-210, 520-575; xone transport/dongle.c:1547-1583; pinned tag and source only.
